entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I think I need to return something. It's my VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is David Chen, and the order number is... VF789012.

Thank you, David. I have your account pulled up. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 33 days ago. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just... it's really **hard to use**. The whole menu system is so **confusing**. I read the **user manual** cover to cover, but I can't get the custom workout screen to save my settings. Honestly, I just **expected more** for the price. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear you're having a frustrating experience. It sounds like it's not meeting your expectations, and I understand completely. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I just feel a bit overwhelmed by it all.

I understand. Okay, I've checked the policy, and I have good news. Our system shows that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 33 days ago, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you so much, Diana.

You're very welcome, David. I'm also noting in your account that you're one of our VIP members. For the inconvenience, I've emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label and also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. You should see that email within the next 5 minutes.
Wow, that's really generous. I appreciate that. You've been a great help.
It's my pleasure to assist. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
